description: This source file defines command-line interface commands for managing a launchd agent, including installing, uninstalling, and checking the status of the service. It includes helper functions to write and remove plist files related to launchd configuration.

classes.name: ServiceRootCommand
classes.description: Main command group for service-related subcommands (install, uninstall, status)

classes.name: ServiceInstall
classes.description: Command to install and load the launch agent

classes.name: ServiceUninstall
classes.description: Command to remove and unload the launch agent

classes.name: ServiceStatus
classes.description: Command to check the status of the launch agent

methods.name: writePlist
methods.description: Creates and writes the launchd plist file with the specified executable

methods.name: removePlist
methods.description: Removes the launchd plist file if it exists

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the command logic for install, uninstall, and status commands
